summary: Iteration 2 frontend-only testing focused on the new theme system + dragonfly SVG icons + regression across all 8 feature pages. All requested items PASS. Home renders with 8 inline SVG dragonfly icons (react-native-svg) — no butterfly emoji in the brand/header. Theme picker button (🎨) opens the modal which shows all 4 themes (Sunset Warmth, Ocean Depths, Forest Sanctuary, Midnight Sacred) each with an emoji, name, description and 6-swatch palette preview + selected checkmark. Selecting a theme updates the home background immediately (verified computed style: ocean = rgb(13,36,56) = #0d2438). Theme persists across full page reload (via /app/frontend/src/utils/storage) — after reload, home-screen bg still rgb(13,36,56) and modal shows 'ocean' with the 2px selected border. Selecting Forest and then navigating to journal/notes/quotes/planner/declutter/affirmations/feedback all succeed and each screen's PageHeader/StackHeader adopts the forest palette (dark green backgrounds visible in screenshots). Navigation to Reset Toolkit also works and shows themed colors. Zero red-screen errors. Persistent non-blocking warnings from iteration 1 still present (unchanged): 'Unexpected text node' console error (2 occurrences when entering /reset) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' library warning. Also the ℠ service-mark still visually wraps as 'SM' on Boss Mode Planner℠ and 143 Life Notes℠ (already reported in iteration_1).

issues: ℠ superscript still renders as separate 'SM' next to title on PageHeader (e.g., 'Boss Mode Planner℠', '143 Life Notes℠'). Repeat of iteration_1 finding — not yet addressed.

react_native_issues.component: reset.tsx (or a shared component rendered on /reset)
react_native_issues.issue: Console error still fires on entering the Reset screen: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' Likely stray whitespace/text between sibling JSX inside a <View>. Non-blocking on web but will break native builds. Reference: /app/frontend/app/reset.tsx (fires twice on mount).

Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Library-originated, non-blocking. Track when upgrading react-native-safe-area-context / react-native-gesture-handler.

action_items: Locate and remove the stray whitespace/text node inside a <View> on the Reset screen (still logs 'Unexpected text node' twice on /reset). Grep for '>\s*\n\s*{' vs '> {' patterns or a stray '.' between JSX siblings.

Replace ℠ character in Stack.Screen titles and PageHeader titles with a styled superscript <Text> (fontSize ~10, lineHeight small, textAlignVertical top) — currently the character wraps to a second visual token 'SM'.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme system is clean: zustand store (useThemeStore) + hook (useTheme) + persistence via storage util. Consumer components correctly rebuild StyleSheet inside useMemo keyed on theme.
DragonflyIcon uses react-native-svg primitives (Svg/Path/Circle/Ellipse) — renders as inline <svg> on web, confirmed 8 SVGs on home screen.
ThemePickerModal correctly reads currentKey from store and shows a 2px gold border + checkmark on the active theme; selection is awaited before state update, so persistence is atomic.
_layout.tsx already re-reads theme via useTheme so Stack header colors update live when theme changes.

index.tsx: two feature cards still use emoji icons ('🦋' Quote Cards, '🌿' Reset). Given the user's explicit request 'real dragonfly SVG icons (not butterfly emojis)', consider replacing the '🦋' on Quote Cards with a small DragonflyIcon to fully honor the brand direction — the emoji butterfly still lives on the home card grid.
